name: Raygun Gothic

influenced_by: 1930s-50s science fiction pulp magazine covers and film serials (Flash Gordon)
Streamline Moderne and Art Deco architecture

eras: aesthetic evokes 1930s-50s pulp sci-fi; term popularized by William Gibson
garments: not a fashion look — a retrofuturist design aesthetic (chrome rocket ships, ray guns)
reacts_against: nothing contemporaneous — it names the specific brand of optimistic, chrome-and-fins science fiction imagined before real spaceflight existed.
